faq.a: In Urdu, Hafsah is rendered حفصہ and carries the sense شیرنی، شیر کا بچہ.

faq.q: What are the variants of Hafsah?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Hafsah, hafsah. Script forms are حفصة, حفصه, حفصہ, हफ़्सा.

faq.q: Is Hafsah a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
